prompt: # SYSTEM PROMPT — CODING AI BUILD SPECIFICATION **Project:** Complete "Memphis Design" Landing Page — Single-Attempt, Production-Quality Build **Output Category:** Retro & Pop (1980s Postmodern) **Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the full landing page in one attempt. The visual theme is **Memphis Design**: bold geometric shapes (triangles, squiggles, circles), bright clashing colors, playful patterns, dotted textures, asymmetric layouts, and decorative abstract elements — all executed with **pure CSS** (no images, no inline SVGs). **Fictional Product:** Invent a coherent fictional product (e.g., a playful creative/design SaaS) with a short, punchy brand name fitting the 80s Memphis mood. Write **real, complete English copy** for every section — headlines, subcopy, feature descriptions, testimonial quotes, pricing details, FAQ answers, footer text. Lorem ipsum is prohibited. **Required Sections (in order):** Sticky Header/Nav → Hero → Features (3 cards) → How It Works (3 steps) → Testimonials (3 quotes) → Pricing (3 tiers) → FAQ (accordion, 5–6 items) → Final CTA (with email capture form) → Footer with secondary links. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain semantic and clean; restyling the site must require editing only the CSS file. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Store all tokens in `:root` and override per theme. Map the Memphis palette as follows: **Light Mode (default):** * `--primary: #FF71CE` (Hot Pink), `--secondary: #6A7BB4` (Blue Purple), `--accent-yellow: #FFCE5C`, `--accent-teal: #86CCCA` * `--bg-primary: #FEF9F0` (warm cream — never `#ffffff`; where a near-white is unavoidable use `#fefefe`), `--bg-secondary: #FFF6E5` * `--text-primary: #221E33`, `--text-secondary: #5A5470`, `--text-success: #0E8A5F`, `--text-error: #D6304C` * `--border-default: #221E33` (Memphis uses thick, bold outlines — default borders are 2px solid), `--border-error`, `--border-success` **Dark Mode:** `--bg-primary: #171233`, `--bg-secondary: #241E52`, `--text-primary: #FEF9F0`, `--text-secondary: #B8B0D9`, `--secondary: #9DB1F0` (lightened for contrast), `--text-success: #4ADE9C`, `--text-error: #FF6B81`, `--border-default: #FEF9F0`. * **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with dark text; every dark background token pairs with light text — enforced in both themes. Accent fills (yellow/pink/teal) must always carry `--text-primary` (dark ink) in light mode. Verify 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large display text in both modes. * **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 0px`, `--radius-md: 4px`, `--radius-lg: 12px` (Memphis is sharp; circles use `border-radius: 50%`). `--shadow-sm` and `--shadow-md` must be **hard offset shadows with zero blur** (e.g., `4px 4px 0` / `8px 8px 0` in accent colors) — 80s poster style, not soft modern shadows. * **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` (bouncy, playful easing). * **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`. * **Fonts:** `--font-display`, `--font-base` (see 1.6). ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support * Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on ``. * **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must swap seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring. If `mix-blend-mode` overlays are used, switch blend values per theme (e.g., `multiply` in light, `screen` in dark) via CSS only. * **Persistence:** Store the user's choice in `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Provide a visible toggle in the header using Material Symbols `light_mode`/`dark_mode` icons with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment * Build all layout structures with **Flexbox** (Tailwind flex utilities). Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless an exception is explicitly justified in comments. * **Mobile-First:** Rows convert to columns on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling at any width. Decorative Memphis shapes must never cause overflow — clip them with `overflow: hidden` on their section containers. ### 1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration * Use Tailwind CSS (CDN) for **layout utilities only** (flex, gap, padding, responsive breakpoints). * All Memphis components, shapes, and effects live in `style.css` as reusable BEM classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.shape-triangle`, etc.), ideally within `@layer components`. Never mix naming conventions. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) * **Text:** Load Google Fonts via ``: **'Archivo Black'** for display headings (`--font-display`) and **'Space Grotesk'** for body text (`--font-base`). Headings are bold, uppercase, and geometric. * **Icons:** Use Google Material Symbols (Rounded set) via ``. **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** * **Decorative Memphis art must be pure CSS:** triangles via `clip-path: polygon()`, circles via `border-radius: 50%`, squiggles/zigzags via `repeating-linear-gradient`/`repeating-radial-gradient`, dotted textures via `radial-gradient` pattern backgrounds, tilted elements via `transform: rotate()`, dashed/dotted accent borders via `border` styles. All decorative layers must be `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events: none`. --- ## 2.
